rename.to: ability to read utf8 files by Cake\Filesystem\File

body:
Seems like a case which is missing from tests for sure, from what I can see.

https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/tests/TestCase/Filesystem/FileTest.php

This is intended behavior as in:
https://api.cakephp.org/3.5/source-class-Cake.Filesystem.File.html#355

What PHP version do you use?

A "bug" in PHP might be the cause: [Bug #62119 :: basename broken with non-ASCII-chars](https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=62119).
I don't think it'll be the PHP version, as that bug is for `5.3.13` and the minimum for Cake 3.5.12 is `5.6.0`, but it's a good spot.
So this is not a framework issue, as the language itself seems to have problems here.

I was referring to PHP as the language. This seems to be out of scope of CakePHP.
or does SplFileInfo work?

```php
<?php
$str=[
'ddddd/نام.php',
'نام.php',
'نام فارسی.php',
'/نام فارسی.php',
'ddd/نام فارسی.php',
'/etc/sudoers.d',
'/etc/passwd',
'/etc/',
'.',
'/',

];
foreach($str as $item){
    $info = new SplFileInfo($item);
    echo $info->getFilename();
    echo "\n";
}
//returns
نام.php
 نام.php
 نام فارسی.php
 /نام فارسی.php
 نام فارسی.php
 sudoers.d
 passwd
 /etc
 .
 /
```
just needs a `str_replace`

and about http://php.net/manual/en/function.basename.php
```
Caution

basename() is locale aware, so for it to see the correct basename with multibyte character paths, the matching locale must be set using the setlocale() function.

```
We could convert the existing `basename()` and `dirname()` usage to be `SplFileInfo` as well.

can we have a method for use in this class and other classes if it was necessary ?
`public function safeBasename()` for example
Why wouldn't we make the existing methods 'safe'? Having 2 versions of the same basic feature feels like we are setting developers up to fail.
